## 2. Required columns and per-role rules

Core states required columns inside the role text; it is copied unchanged.

- `prior_low`: single extremum row, fact_kind ef2.extremum.low

## 3. Reference fact kinds and schemas

- **extremum_reference_schema**:
  - **columns**:
    -
      - **name**: instrument_id
      - **dtype**: string
      - **rule**: equals target entity
    -
      - **name**: session_id
      - **dtype**: string
      - **rule**: equals target session
    -
      - **name**: reference_id
      - **dtype**: string
      - **rule**: x1:B(window_set_id); B is unpadded base64url of UTF8; identical on both roles; <=128 codepoints
    -
      - **name**: fact_kind
      - **dtype**: string
      - **rule**: ef2.extremum.high or ef2.extremum.low per role
    -
      - **name**: effective_start_ns
      - **dtype**: utc_ns
      - **rule**: evidence only: end boundary of the upstream window as supplied by the extrema owner
    -
      - **name**: effective_end_ns
      - **dtype**: utc_ns
      - **nullable**: True
      - **rule**: null or greater than start
    -
      - **name**: text
      - **dtype**: string
      - **rule**: equals batch source.snapshot_id (revision binding)
    -
      - **name**: price
      - **dtype**: int64
      - **nullable**: True
      - **rule**: exact extremum coefficient at ConfigSpec.price_unit.scale; null when the upstream owner reported not available
    -
      - **name**: factor_num
      - **dtype**: int64
      - **nullable**: True
      - **rule**: observed governed slots in the upstream window, >= 1 (a zero or negative factor is refused UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT by the shared validator); all-or-none with factor_den (this contract); populated on every priced row and on a partial-shortfall row; NOT populated on a zero-observed shortfall row
    -
      - **name**: factor_den
      - **dtype**: int64
      - **nullable**: True
      - **rule**: required upstream window length N; equal on both roles
    -
      - **name**: known_at_ns
      - **dtype**: utc_ns
      - **nullable**: True
      - **rule**: original knowledge of the extremum; causal in both availability modes
  - **note**: float64 upstream outputs (history.prior_high/low, daily_observations.high/low) are rounded and are NOT accepted as inputs; the I/O layer maps the exact integer coefficients (decision DP-R6).

The schemas are listed for the whole core contract file, that is for all of its producers.

## 4. Config parameters, defaults and who supplies them

- policy_version
- direction
- ratio_num
- ratio_den
- evidence_limit
- direction_values: ["from_high", "from_low"]
- ratio_domain: 0 <= ratio_num/ratio_den <= 1, reduced, den in 1..2^63-1; no default

Parameters are listed as the core contract states them. Where core states a defaults position it is in the parameter text or under rules (`defaults_ledger`); the catalogue adds none.

## 5. Coverage, adjustment, scale, known_at and mode rules

- **mode_rule**: anchored reset batch only (carry mode out of v1); known_at and reconstruction availability modes give identical results; update, restore and merge unsupported; batch and full replay only

Refusal codes the core contract records for this producer (distinct code and raising layer; fixture ids are core ids):

| `DUPLICATE` | not stated | TR09 | two prior_high rows, or shared actual input_id between the two roles |
| `INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION` | not stated | TR08 | unsupported policy label |
| `INCONSISTENT_IDENTITY` | not stated | TR10, TR11, TR12 | row instrument or session differs from the target |
| `INVALID_CONFIG` | not stated | TR01, TR02, TR03, TR04, TR05, TR06 (+2 more) | ratio above 1 (extension ratio) under ef2-retrace1 |
| `INVALID_SCHEMA` | not stated | TR13 | library check of this contract (the shared validator does not enforce it): wrong fact_kind, only one of factor_num/factor_den populated, a priced row without factors, or wrong slot kind |
| `INVALID_UNIT` | not stated | TR14 | price unit scale or currency differs from the config |
| `UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT` | not stated | TR18, TR15 | factor_num or factor_den <= 0 on a REFERENCE row: refused by the existing shared validator (validation.py: adjustment rational factors must be positive), including a zero-observed upstream shortfall written as 0/N |
| `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY` | not stated | TR16 | update, restore or merge requested |
